chunks: And it is narrated from Dāwūd al-Raqqī, who said:

I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, Abā al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar, and Abā al-Ḥasan ʿAlī ibn Mūsā, عليه السلام, and they were saying: “Whoever comes to the grave of al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī, عليه السلام, on ʿArafah, Allāh, Exalted is He, will make him coolness of chest.”

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلِيَّ بْنَ مُوسَى: Imam ʿAlī ibn Mūsā al-Riḍā عليه السلام
key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar al-Kāẓim عليه السلام
key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ جَعْفَرَ بْنَ مُحَم: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.ثَلِجَ الصَّدْرِ: coolness and tranquility of the chest, meaning inward calm and reassurance
key_terms.دَاوُدَ الرَّقِّيِّ: Dāwūd al-Raqqī, the narrator transmitting this report
key_terms.قَبْرَ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ: the grave of Imam al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام on the day of ʿArafah?
ai.summary: This hadith speaks of the merit of visiting the grave of Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام on the day of ʿArafah. It promises that Allah, Exalted is He, grants such a visitor inner calmness, reassurance, and serenity of heart.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3170 - It is narrated from Dawud al-Raqqi, who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah (Ja‘far ibn Muhammad), Abu al-Hasan (Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim), and Abu al-Hasan (Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as)) all saying:
"Whoever visits the grave of Imam Hussain ibn Ali (as) on the Day of Arafah, Allah (swt), the Exalted, will turn their heart into one of contentment and tranquility."
